miniProject.title: Execution and memory mapping with a PTX and SASS evidence bundle
miniProject.brief: Build the execution model in kernellab: an explicit-memory baseline, grid-stride tails, a block-local publication test, a source to SASS bundle, a native extension and a capability manifest. Predictions precede profiles throughout, and unsupported features are audited statically. The baseline, manifest and selector carry into later timing work.
steps: Write an explicit-memory single-precision vector add in `kernels/cuda/map.cu`. Check every result against an independent host reference, and keep the tests.

Predict sector, bank and occupancy behavior before running, using TensorTonic Occupancy Calculator, Coalescing Counter and Bank Conflict Analyzer. Check predictions with event timings and compiler resource reports, and keep the derivation sheet.

Convert the baseline to a grid-stride loop with checked tails, including empty inputs. Pair uniform and divergent kernels, annotate the retained branch and reconvergence in PTX and SASS, and keep the annotated bundle.

Build a two-warp block-local publication test with a barrier, release store and acquire load. Check the payload on the host, write the scope and progress audit, and keep racy variants as analyzed cases only.

Bundle source, PTX, cubin and SASS for the bounded kernel with compiler resource tables. Test one disassembly-backed paired timing hypothesis with event timing, and keep the bundle with the hypothesis report.
Build an inference-only vector-add extension with an explicit shape and device contract. Test views, alignment and rejections plus lifetime on a non-default stream, and keep the rejection matrix.

Write a capability manifest from device queries and a selector that falls back to the baseline, with dispatch tests and automatic against forced-baseline timing. Audit TMA, clusters, `wgmma` (Hopper) and `tcgen05` (Blackwell) statically unless your GPU has them.
deliverables: `kernels/cuda/map.cu` with the baseline, index map, grid-stride tails and host reference tests.
The derivation sheet with sector, bank and occupancy predictions beside measured evidence and resource reports.
The publication test with audit, SASS bundle with hypothesis, extension with rejection matrix, and capability manifest.

rubric.pass: The baseline matches the host reference, the index map is verified, and tails pass with an empty path.
rubric.strong: An injected defect is kept as a regression that the reference catches.

rubric.pass: Sector, bank and occupancy derivations precede runs and are reconciled with measured evidence.
rubric.strong: The paired hypothesis names the disassembly lines it depends on and a falsifying signal.

rubric.pass: Your publication test passes through release and acquire, and dispatch tests cover fallback branches.
rubric.strong: The audit separates initialization from publication, and paths your GPU cannot run are marked as static audit.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone laboratory: the baseline, tails, publication test, SASS bundle, extension contract and capability manifest. Later sections time and profile these kernels and reuse the selector.
